question: Does a natural predicted-mask crop add value beyond original RGB and improve over the gray-background dual view?

data.test_policy: Do not read final-test images or labels

crop.source: experiment-005 selected no-prompt predicted binary mask
crop.definition: tight mask bounding box plus 10% of bbox width/height on each side, clamped to RGB bounds
crop.clip_preprocessing: pad natural crop to square with CLIP mean color, resize 224, OpenAI CLIP normalization

model.name: B4
model.architecture: original 512->64 ReLU; crop 512->64 ReLU; concatenate; dropout 0.5; 128->5 Softplus

training.selection: minimum development normalized nutrient MAE epoch per seed

evaluation.primary: mean energy/protein/carbohydrate/fat MAE divided by training means
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 paired bootstrap draws of development plate groups, seed 0
